notes: First2 images both include same primary page53 table;7 primary distributions stored once with both sources
All20 original-net bridge phenotypes retained;19 have q60<0.05, COGI does not; Mean/GMI redundant, not19 independent findings
LBGI adjusted linear beta is negative while unadjusted Spearman is positive; different statistics, not a tested adjustment-induced sign reversal
GRADE_eugly is contribution of euglycemic values to totalGRADE, not TIR
Positive distributions are14 diet-specific A summaries, not bridge populations or per-meal distributions
